product_updates.title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
product_updates.content: OpenAI has not yet said what its plans are for the future of travel. But Sonder founder Francis Davidson is a well-known figure in the travel industry.

product_updates.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
product_updates.content: New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.

product_updates.title: All 7 Anthropic founders will each cash out about $250M in IPO
product_updates.content: Each of the seven co-founders plans to sell exactly the same number of shares in the IPO, which would bring each of them about $250 million in cash at the midpoint of the price range while leaving the group in control of the company.

product_updates.title: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
product_updates.content: The deal comes a few weeks after Oura postponed its up to $2.2 billion IPO indefinitely, citing “uncertainty in the IPO market.”

product_updates.title: PSI is trying to make a business out of AI-driven scientific discovery
product_updates.content: PSI used an unreleased Anthropic model to answer a fundamental question about quantum computing that scientists have pursued for nearly two decades.

product_updates.title: OpenAI rolls out new business profiles, making ChatGPT just a little bit more like Google
product_updates.content: OpenAI is looking to make ChatGPT a more robust consumer discovery engine, and a host of new features seek to empower businesses to help it do that.

product_updates.title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
product_updates.content: As participants talk, Claude can draft the plan being discussed, map out a timeline on a whiteboard, answer questions in the meeting chat, and access connected work apps to retrieve information, such as last year's figures.

product_updates.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy: a timeline
product_updates.content: The affair could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.

product_updates.title: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips
product_updates.content: Google's new tensor processing units (TPUs) broaden its chip portfolio to more use cases: confidential model training and more memory capacity.

product_updates.title: Meta’s AI agent Muse lands on Apple Watch and Android Wear OS
product_updates.content: Users can now interact with Meta’s AI assistant through voice calls, text messages, or dictation on their Apple Watch.

technical_breakthroughs.title: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI
technical_breakthroughs.content: Researcher finds 35,000 Grok Build apps wide open to anyone who looked for them.

technical_breakthroughs.title: Introducing AlphaProof Code: a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth
technical_breakthroughs.content: AlphaProof Code agents wrote three million lines of proofs in Lean to verify Signal’s core encryption.
